project.name: TrueLicense
project.description: TrueLicense is an open source engine for license management on the Java Virtual Machine. Due to its functional and modular design TrueLicense scales from simple to complex licensing schemas. TrueLicense features various interfaces for managing free trial periods, subscriptions, multiple editions, internationalization, privacy protection and more.

requireFilesDontExist.message: Put test sources under src/test/scala instead - in any language. A src/test/java directory activates the java-test-sources profile, which binds maven-failsafe-plugin 2.22.2; that combination reports "Tests run: 0" and leaves the build green instead of failing. See the comment on this execution in the root POM.

fail.message: Constant string obfuscation produced nothing in ${project.artifactId}: no class in ${project.build.outputDirectory} carries a method name synthesized by ObfuscateClassesTask. The obfuscate-main-classes goal did not run or did not apply. If this module genuinely has no constant strings, set truelicense.obfuscate.verify.skip=true; if it obfuscates only named constants and so synthesizes no method name, set truelicense.obfuscate.verify.relaxed=true.
